title: A dynamic format string may name its own measure
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "Fs", 'Sales'[_Self Ref FormatString], "Small", CALCULATE ( 'Sales'[_Self Ref FormatString], Sales[Item] = "A" ) )

source.quote: You can reference the measure itself in its dynamic format string directly by using its name, such as [Measure A], or indirectly by using SELECTEDMEASURE().
source.supports: [Self Ref] in its own format string is the measure

source.quote: The internal measure for the format string is [_Sales Amount FormatString].
source.supports: the internal measure that holds it

derivation: In total [Self Ref] is 2002000 > 10000: "#,0". For item A it is 500: "0.00".
